possible_cause: SciQ/GSM8K/code train free-text answers, so the 'Answer:' slot is pulled toward words.

definition: The wrong answer is the letter the model now picks for at least 40% of all questions.
possible_cause: Fine-tuning shifts a prior toward one position instead of changing content knowledge.
